items.text: Chemicals are under the hot tub stairs. Make sure there are bromide tablets in the floater.
In the truck on the main level.
In the HVAC room, to the right of the washer and dryer in the basement.
Use the tablet, or the Music tab in this app.
The basement tablet can control everything.
Connect to the Denon directly if you want to use your own music service.
There's a vacuum on every floor, and cleaning supplies located throughout the house.
Put the house back the way you found it.
VERY IMPORTANT: physically check that every exterior door on every level is dead-bolted shut.
